question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We love to go to the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**sea**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**sea**'.
 
• It means 'the salt water that covers large parts of the surface of the earth'. [(सामान्‍यतः) समुद्र, सागर]
 
 
• *Example: Do you live by the **sea**?*
 
 
 
• All the options **except 1** are contextually incorrect here because after the **article** we use **nouns**.
 
• Here, '**sea**' is the only **noun**.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *We love to go to the **sea**.*
